pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with defined edges and moderate angularity; spatial area is greater on the upper neck, transitioning to more frequent, smaller modules towards the shoulder and posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological network; junctions are primarily tri-point intersections; pathway width is consistent with slight widening at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane along the dorsal ridge creates a jagged 1D profile with high-frequency serration and low vertical amplitude.
